LESSON: SLAVERY AND SERVITUDE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 2.3: Slavery and Servitude

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Slavery and Servitude. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why has slavery and servitude existed for thousands of years?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
2. explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SLAVERY AND SERVITUDE
This lesson teaches Slavery and Servitude for Grade 7 SOCIAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Slavery and Servitude using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Slavery and Servitude above.
2. Explain Slavery and Servitude to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Slavery and Servitude.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Slavery and Servitude with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Slavery and Servitude important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why has slavery and servitude existed for thousands of years?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
2. explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
